sentiment.sum: XRP chatter is upbeat on Ripple testing XRP as payment collateral and an OKX stake, but most posts are promotional and price is flat near $1.39.
WLD is the top 24h gainer (+11-14% to about $0.557), helped by OpenAI IPO talk and new Solana/SwissBorg listings, though hype accounts dominate.
MON is stuck near $0.025 after a 25% weekly drop, with bearish trader posts offset by steady builder activity (Monad Blitz Pune, Monad Watch explorer).
ETH lags near $2,500 with ETF outflows of about -$56M and outsized ETH long liquidations.
BTC recovered to about $82.6k after a $1B+ long liquidation flush, with spot ETF flows turning slightly positive (+$21M).
Spot XRP ETFs saw +$11.3M inflows this week and positive flows while BTC/ETH ETFs bled; lots of hype posts discounted.
Thin WLD chatter, mostly short setups near resistance around $0.50.
Monad shipped the open-source Typewriter sequencing framework (Keone Hon); community chatter mildly positive, low volume.
ETH ETFs had -$72.5M outflows, offset by institutional tokenization news (Consensys and ClearToken).
US spot BTC ETFs saw about -$244M outflows; traders eye an $80k sweep, offset slightly by golden-cross talk.
